summary: Round 6 passes with no blocker. All eleven ADV fixes hold, and each is pinned by a test that fails on 8eafbc3 (20 failed, 29 passed) and passes on 2a9d421 (49 passed). The four older files pass unchanged (85, 15, 19, 2). My 65 probes on a temp archive of 2a9d421 all pass, including the ADV-11 staging with no partial set and no temp file left. The three round 5 findings are fixed. Two Minor items and three Nits remain.
nonblocking_findings: A6-1 [Minor] review-a: harness/model-guide/publish.ts:12-48 and harness/model-guide/real-work.ts:8-20 with harness/model-guide-tests/adversarial.test.ts:328, 436: five new refusal lines are named in the tool headers but no test asserts them. Grep for `publish: bad docs root`, `publish: bad approval record`, `publish: write`, `input-check: input`, and `input-check: json` in harness/model-guide-tests prints 0 matches. The X tests assert only `^input-check: \S+\n$`, so any check name passes. Probes give the header lines today, and each fix fails on 8eafbc3, so the behavior is pinned. A line rename would pass. Fix: assert the exact line in the ADV-1, ADV-2, ADV-11, X-missing, and X-badjson tests.

A6-2 [Minor] review-a: harness/model-guide/publish.ts:227-249 with harness/model-guide-tests/adversarial.test.ts:769-793: the ADV-11 test asserts only a non-zero exit and the absence of `docs/real-work.html`. It does not assert the `publish: write <path>` line and it does not assert that no `.publish-*.tmp` file stays under `docs/`. My probe on a temp archive of 2a9d421 gives `publish: write locked/new.html`, exit 2, empty stderr, no partial set, and 0 temp files, so the behavior is right today. A cleanup regression would pass this test. Also the rename loop at publish.ts:249 is not wrapped: a rename failure would exit 1 with a stack trace and leave staged temp files. No tested fixture reaches it. Fix: assert the exact line and `find docs -name '.publish-*.tmp'` empty in the test; wrap the rename loop.

A6-3 [Nit] review-a: harness/model-guide-tests/leak-guard.test.ts:30-47: a symlink to a folder under the test folder contributes only its link line, so a leak file inside that folder passes the guard. Before the rewrite the guard threw ENOENT and failed closed. No test plants a directory symlink; harness/model-guide-tests/adversarial.test.ts:850 notes the fixture avoids one. The folder holds 0 tracked symlinks today. Fix: recurse a directory target, or add a test that pins the choice.

A6-4 [Nit] review-a: harness/model-guide-tests/adversarial.test.ts:428-439, 441-447: two tests promise `exit 2` in the name but call `expectNoCrash`, which accepts status 0 with no further assertion. A tool that accepted bad JSON or a JSON null root with exit 0 would pass. My probes give exit 2 today. Fix: assert `result.status === 2` in those two cases.

A6-5 [Nit] review-a: measure/tracks/model_guide/test-strategy.md:24-60 (Phase 1 gate commands): the new file `harness/model-guide-tests/adversarial.test.ts` is not listed, and its run command appears only in the plan. `leak-guard.test.ts` is also absent, so the gap follows the existing pattern. Fix: add the fifth line to section 2.1.

Probes cover: control preview exit 0; ADV-3 mode 000 directory gives exit 2, `preview: unreadable docs/lockdir`, empty stderr, no .tmp; ADV-3 mode 000 docs root and a missing docs root each give exit 2, one `preview: unreadable docs` line, empty stderr, no .tmp; ADV-4 a FIFO gives exit 2, `preview: refused path <abs>`, empty stderr, no .tmp and no hang; the dangling link gives exit 2 with the exact line; a docs root symlink in preview gives exit 2, `preview: refused path <abs docs>`, and the target stays untouched.

Probes of publish.ts: a docs root symlink gives exit 2, `publish: bad docs root`, empty stderr, and no write into the link target (ADV-1); a record with no approved_by and no date gives exit 2, `publish: bad approval record`, and no file (ADV-2, spec glossary line 211); a read-only target folder gives exit 2, `publish: write locked/new.html`, empty stderr, no partial set, and 0 `.publish-*.tmp` files under docs (ADV-11); a mode 000 docs root gives exit 2 and only `publish: drift <path>` lines, with `.` for the root and no empty path (ADV-5); a preview base of `null` gives exit 2, `publish: bad preview base`, empty stderr (ADV-10).

Probes of real-work.ts: a missing path, a folder path, bad JSON, a JSON null root, and a non-string route each give exit 2, one `input-check: <check>` line, empty stderr, and no output file (ADV-6). A `private_note` coverage key stays out of the written real-work.json at exit 0 (ADV-7). A work type and a rating axis named `__proto__` both stay in the output at exit 0 (ADV-8). A negative count gives exit 2 and no output; counts of 1e308 are refused (ADV-9).

ADV-11 correctness: publish.ts:191-196 lstats the docs root before the drift walk; publish.ts:227-248 stages every approved file in its target folder, then drops all staged temp files on failure, and only publish.ts:249 renames. My probe confirms no partial set and no temp file left. The drift walk at publish.ts:198-223 runs before staging, so a temp file from a crashed run would show as drift and fail closed.

ADV-3 and ADV-4 in preview.sh: preview.sh:112-183 replaces both find calls with one Python scan. The scan lstats the docs root, walks every folder with listdir, refuses a symlink or another non-regular entry, and reports the first unreadable entry. It runs after the input check and before mkdir and cp, so no refusal writes near the preview folder. Round 5 finding A5-1 (an unreadable directory gave exit 1 and a find message) is fixed and pinned by a test that fails on 8eafbc3. Round 5 finding A5-2 (a FIFO hung the run) is fixed and pinned the same way. Round 5 finding A5-3 (the dangling-link line was unasserted) is fixed by the exact-line test at adversarial.test.ts:263-273.

ADV-6 to ADV-9 in real-work.ts: real-work.ts:75 defines isCount as a non-negative safe integer, real-work.ts:80 refuses a sum that leaves the safe range, and real-work.ts:88 validates each row before any write. real-work.ts:469-477 builds the coverage output from an explicit key list of spec EV4 plus unknown_runs and other_runs, so no extra key reaches the public file. real-work.ts:350 and real-work.ts:460 build ratings and work types with Object.fromEntries, so a `__proto__` name stays an own key. All refusals run before the mkdir at real-work.ts:502, so no write happens on a refused run.

ADV-12 and ADV-13 in leak-guard.test.ts: the walk returns {rel, text} entries, a symlink contributes its link line plus the target text when the target is a plain file, and hits() compares lower-cased text. Nested directories, regular files, and file symlink targets are all still scanned, and the match is now a superset of the old one. The one narrowing is a directory target, recorded as A6-3.

Anti-pattern checks: A3 clean. Grep for digit-only count patterns in adversarial.test.ts returns 0 matches; the tests assert exact lines, exit codes, and full snapshots. A4: each missing-deliverable fixture (unreadable folder, FIFO, docs root link, record without owner, locked destination, hostile export) fails on 8eafbc3 and passes at 2a9d421, so the checks are not vacuous. Two tests permit exit 0 where the name promises exit 2; recorded as A6-4. A5 clean: plan 1.18 and 1.19 counts match my reruns.
